crossRefs.note: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire…
The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

translations.web: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
translations.bsb: The two doors were made of cypress wood, and each had two folding panels.
translations.kjv: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
translations.asv: and two doors of fir-wood: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
